home.heroText:
Use this app to compare time across cities, organize them your way, and see the current time in each place at a glance.
Create reminders for specific cities to keep people, plans, and routines in sync across time zones.
home.realUseCasesSubtitle: Why do You even need the app?

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.paragraph1: Set city-based reminders for calls, meetings, handoffs, or daily routines without doing timezone math in your head.
notifications.paragraph2: {siteName} helps you choose the right local moment first, then reminds you when that moment arrives.

synchronisation.title: Calendar Events
synchronisation.paragraph1: See calendar events in the context of the cities that matter to you, so calls, meetings, and plans are easier to place on the timeline.
synchronisation.paragraph2: {siteName} helps connect scheduled moments with local time, making it clearer what is happening today, tomorrow, or later across time zones.

countdowns.title: Countdowns
countdowns.paragraph1: See how much time is left until a specific hour in another city, even when that city is already in tomorrow.
countdowns.paragraph2: Countdowns make planning feel concrete: no more guessing whether a deadline, livestream, flight, or call is one hour away or half a day away.

familyAbroad.title: Family Abroad
familyAbroad.text: Know when it's a good time to call.

travelers.title: Travelers
travelers.text: Adapt to new time zones faster.

worldClock.title: World Clock
worldClock.lead: Compare current local time across the cities that matter to you.
worldClock.description: TimeCross gives you a personal world clock for people, trips, calls, and routines across time zones. Add cities, rename them your way, and keep the important hours close at hand.
worldClock.personalClockTitle: A world clock built around your cities
worldClock.personalClockText: Keep a focused list of places instead of scanning a giant table of time zones. TimeCross lets you order, rename, and compare the cities you actually care about.
worldClock.compareCitiesTitle: See today, tomorrow, and time differences at a glance
worldClock.compareCitiesText: Day markers and relative offsets make it easier to know when a city has moved into tomorrow, when someone is likely awake, and how far apart two places are.

free.title: Is {siteName} free?
free.paragraph1: Yes. {siteName} is free to download and use for the core experience: tracking favorite cities, comparing time zones, and checking timelines across the day.
free.paragraph2: If paid features are added later, they will be clearly marked before you enable them. The app is designed to be useful without forcing you into an account or subscription.

offline.title: Does it work offline?
offline.paragraph1: Yes. {siteName} can calculate city times and time zone offsets on your device, so the main timeline and city list continue to work without an internet connection.
offline.paragraph2: Some things still depend on your device settings, such as the system clock and the time zone database provided by the operating system.

account.title: Do I need to register an account?
account.paragraph1: No. You can start using {siteName} right away without creating an account. Your cities, ordering, display format, and other preferences are kept locally on your device.
account.paragraph2: That also means the app stays lightweight: there is no login step just to check whether it is a good time to call, meet, or send a message.

platforms.title: Which platforms are supported?
platforms.paragraph1: {siteName} is available for iOS. The Android version is in progress and is being built to keep the same simple city list, timeline view, and notification flow.
platforms.paragraph2: The website also provides a lightweight preview of the core experience, so you can explore how the timeline and city comparison work before installing the app.

notifications.title: How do I enable Notifications?
notifications.paragraph1: Open the app menu, go to Settings, and choose Notifications. From there you can enable reminders for the cities and times that matter to you.
notifications.paragraph2: Your device may also ask for notification permission. If notifications do not appear, check that {siteName} is allowed to send alerts in your system settings.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.overviewText: {siteName} is designed to help you compare time across cities without requiring an account. The app and website aim to keep personal data collection minimal.
privacy.infoText1: If you contact us through the website contact form, your name, email address, and message are sent to {siteName} support so we can reply to your request.
privacy.infoText2: The contact form is processed by our website backend and forwarded to our support email address.
privacy.infoText3: Do not include sensitive information in support messages unless it is necessary for your request.
privacy.localDataText1: {siteName} may store preferences locally on your device or browser, such as selected cities, city order, and time format. This information is used to make the app feel familiar when you return.
privacy.localDataText2: Local data is not an account backup. Clearing browser storage, deleting the app, or resetting device data may remove these preferences.
privacy.notificationsText: If you enable notifications, {siteName} uses your device notification system to show reminders you choose. You can disable notification permissions in your device settings.
privacy.thirdPartyText: Opening store links, email links, or external support links may take you to services operated by third parties. Their privacy practices are governed by their own policies.
privacy.contactPrefix: For privacy questions, contact us at

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.acceptanceText: By using {siteName} or this website, you agree to these Terms of Use. If you do not agree, please do not use the app or website.
terms.purposeText: {siteName} helps compare times across cities, plan across time zones, and understand local time differences. It is a planning tool, not a guarantee that every schedule, calendar, or device clock is always correct.
terms.responsibilityText1: You are responsible for checking important times before relying on them for travel, work, medical, legal, financial, or other high-stakes decisions.
terms.responsibilityText2: Time zone rules can change, and device settings may affect displayed times.
terms.acceptableUseText: You agree not to misuse the app or website, attempt to disrupt its operation, or use it in a way that violates applicable laws.
terms.availabilityText: We may update, change, pause, or discontinue parts of {siteName} as the product evolves. Features described on the website may change over time.
terms.contactPrefix: Questions about these terms can be sent to

meetingTimePlanner.title: Meeting Time Planner
meetingTimePlanner.lead: Find meeting hours that make sense across cities and time zones.
meetingTimePlanner.description: Use TimeCross to compare local hours before you schedule a call, handoff, livestream, class, or family chat. Line up the same moment across cities and spot better meeting windows faster.
meetingTimePlanner.previewText: The timeline view lines up city hours so you can scan today, yesterday, and tomorrow without doing timezone math.
meetingTimePlanner.compareTitle: Compare cities before you send the invite
meetingTimePlanner.compareText: See where each city is in the day and avoid guessing whether a time is too early, too late, or already tomorrow.
meetingTimePlanner.planText: Rename cities for clients, friends, family, or routines and keep the places you coordinate with in a clear order.

timeZoneConverter.title: Time Zone Converter for Cities
timeZoneConverter.lead: Pick any city, enter a time, and see the matching local time across your saved cities and time zones.
timeZoneConverter.description: Pick a city, date, and time. TimeCross shows the same moment in the places you care about, with local dates, time differences, and day markers.
timeZoneConverter.toolText: Use your saved TimeCross cities as the conversion list. Change the source city or time and the results update across every city below.
timeZoneConverter.emptyText: Add a city to start converting time zones.
timeZoneConverter.convertTitle: Convert one moment, not just an offset
timeZoneConverter.convertText: Time zones change with daylight saving rules and local dates. The converter works from a specific city and time so the result stays tied to a real moment.
timeZoneConverter.contextText: See whether another city is still on the same day, already tomorrow, or behind you yesterday before you schedule, call, or travel.
timeZoneConverter.useCasesTitle: Common time zone conversion use cases
timeZoneConverter.useCasesLead: Use TimeCross for the time conversions people search for every day: city to city, UTC to local time, and meeting times across time zones.

cityToCity.title: Convert time between cities
cityToCity.text: Convert London time to New York, Tokyo, Dubai, Sydney, or the cities saved in your TimeCross list.

utc.title: Compare UTC with local time
utc.text: Check UTC time against real city time, or use fixed GMT and UTC offsets when a schedule is written as UTC+3 or UTC-5.

meeting.title: Plan meetings across time zones
meeting.text: See whether a chosen time lands today, tomorrow, or yesterday in another city before you send an invite.

timeZoneConverter.examplesTitle: Example time zone conversions by city
timeZoneConverter.examplesLead: These examples are calculated from 10:00 in each city using current time zone rules, so daylight saving changes stay accurate.

what.title: What is a time zone converter?
what.text: A time zone converter shows what the same moment means in different cities. For example, 10:00 in London can become 05:00 in New York and 18:00 in Tokyo, depending on the date and local time zone rules.

dst.title: Does TimeCross handle daylight saving time?
dst.text: Yes, when you choose real cities. TimeCross uses city time zones, so daylight saving changes are handled through the selected city’s local rules. Fixed UTC/GMT offsets stay fixed.

cities.title: Can I convert time between cities instead of UTC offsets?
cities.text: Yes. Choose a source city and time, then TimeCross shows the matching local time across your saved cities. This is usually easier than comparing raw offsets like UTC+1 or UTC-5.

offsets.title: What is the difference between a city time zone and a fixed UTC offset?
offsets.text: A city time zone, such as London or New York, can change offset during the year because of daylight saving time. A fixed offset, such as UTC+3, never changes.
